formats.name: The auction
formats.body: A mock IPL auction with a fintech valuation twist. Teams bid real strategy for fictional stakes, and the room finds out who can price a player nobody else wants.

formats.name: The talk
formats.body: Someone who actually works in the space comes and talks about it. Our biggest turnout yet was a room of eighty listening to Amol Bajpai on crypto, blockchain and DeFi.

formats.name: The pitch
formats.body: A Shark-Tank-style night where teams pitch and get taken apart in public. Judged on whether the pitch survives contact with someone who knows the scams.

faqs.q: Do I need a finance background?
faqs.a: No. Curiosity and a willingness to argue about IPL auctions is preferred. The committee is built for students who'd rather learn finance by breaking it a little.

faqs.q: What actually happens at a session?
faqs.a: One of three formats: a mock auction with a fintech valuation twist, a talk from someone who works in the space, or a pitch night where teams get taken apart in public. Whichever it is, you will be asked an opinion.
Eleven students across leadership and six portfolios, under the guidance of our faculty conveners.
On campus at Vidyalankar Institute of Technology, Wadala (East), Mumbai.
